source: Japanese Neo Premium File 2, CD Promo (1999), Southern Islands and Unnumbered Promos (1998) checklist pages at japanesepokemoncards.net
caveats: Only entries with a Kanto Pokédex number were imported.
Collector-number fields are null because no reliable set collector number was established from the source pages.
Release-date precision is recorded separately; year-only and month-only dates are not represented as exact release days.
The CD Promo page reports 10 total cards but lists 11 entries; this source discrepancy is retained for review.
No card images were copied. Source-image reuse rights have not been confirmed.
All records remain verificationStatus=unverified until checked against physical cards.
